_comment: Known-answer fixtures for js/rhythm.js. Every expected value here is either analytically derivable by hand or computed independently in Python (numpy) — never captured from this implementation's own output. A test that snapshots its own implementation proves only that the code is deterministic.
_no_corpus_data: Contains no material from the Sharma et al. deposit. Corpus-derived checks live in the conditional block of rhythm.test.mjs and run only when gitignored data/coda-corpus.json is present.

npvi.name: isochronous
npvi.derivation: every adjacent pair is identical, so each term |a-b|/mean is 0

npvi.name: two-equal
npvi.derivation: minimum valid input, one pair, identical

npvi.name: tempo-invariance-check
npvi.derivation: same as alternating-2to1 scaled 10x; nPVI must be unchanged

npvi.name: single-interval
npvi.derivation: fewer than 2 intervals: undefined, must be NaN not 0

fdr.name: benjamini-hochberg-worked
fdr.derivation: n=5; q_k = min over j>=k of p_j*n/j. p*n/rank = .05,.05,.05,.05,.05 so all clamp to 0.05

cohensD.name: one-pooled-sd-apart
cohensD.derivation: means 3 and 4; both sample sd = sqrt(2.5); pooled = sqrt(2.5); d = -1/sqrt(2.5)
